description:
Addresses findings from the /review on the Phase 4 branch
(review/octo-3di, commits 5f56554..0ac4fff). Phase 4 MVP
shipped an end-to-end interactive TUI on top of OTP 28 raw
mode, but several gaps stand between that and a real match
for upstream pi-mono.

Three themes across the children:

  1. **Upstream parity** — port the specific test scenarios
     from pi-mono's keys/stdin-buffer/input/tui-render suites
     (cataloged in docs/port-map/tui.md §14). Match both the
     quality and intent, not just the surface.
  2. **OTP correctness** — crash-safe tty restoration, per-
     session Registry scoping, proper test coverage of
     GenServer lifecycles.
  3. **Pure-first, multi-head-first** — tighten the remaining
     places where we're carrying imperative / convenience
     shortcuts over cleaner pattern-matched alternatives.

Also ports upstream's system prompt — the single biggest lever
for the model's tool-use behavior in Interactive mode.

Blocks Phase 5+ so the TUI foundation is solid before we grow
the provider set.
title: [EPIC] Phase 4 review cleanup: upstream parity + OTP correctness
